tools.name: archive_stale_notes
tools.description: Finds notes in the knowledge base database that have not been updated in a given number of days and moves their files into an archive folder, updating each note's stored path. Returns the list of notes that were moved.

params.name: db_path
params.description: Path to the SQLite notes database

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Age threshold in days since last update

params.name: archive_folder
params.description: Archive folder name under the root

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path


def _unique_target(directory: Path, name: str) -> Path:
    candidate = directory / name
    counter = 1
    while candidate.exists():
        candidate = directory / f"{Path(name).stem}_{counter}{Path(name).suffix}"
        counter += 1
    return candidate


def archive_stale_notes(db_path: str, notes_root: str, older_than_days: int, archive_folder: str = "archive") -> list:
    root = Path(notes_root).resolve()
    archive_dir = root / archive_folder
    cutoff = (datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=older_than_days)).isoformat()
    moved = []

    with closing(sqlite3.connect(db_path)) as connection:
        cursor = connection.cursor()
        cursor.execute(
            "SELECT id, title, path FROM notes WHERE updated_at < ? AND path NOT LIKE ?",
            (cutoff, f"{archive_folder}/%"),
        )
        stale_rows = cursor.fetchall()

        archive_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        for note_id, title, relative_path in stale_rows:
            source = (root / relative_path).resolve()
            if root not in source.parents or not source.is_file():
                continue
            target = _unique_target(archive_dir, source.name)
            shutil.move(str(source), str(target))
            new_relative = str(target.relative_to(root))
            cursor.execute("UPDATE notes SET path = ? WHERE id = ?", (new_relative, note_id))
            moved.append({"id": note_id, "title": title, "from": relative_path, "to": new_relative})

        connection.commit()

    return moved
